notes: F0 and E0 have no edge to K1/S1/S2/S3 anywhere in this table -- they belong to a different object_type entirely, which structurally enforces SECB-FAIL-LEARN-001 section 4's 'F0 and E0 MUST NOT transition directly to K1, S1, S2, or S3' as a fact about the table shape (no cross-object-type edges exist at all in this data model), not merely as an omitted same-type edge.
SkillCandidate S0 has no direct edge to S2 or S3 -- a candidate cannot skip evaluation (S1) or signed approval (S2) (SCEN-12).

SkillCandidate ROLLED_BACK has no edge to S2 or S3 -- a rolled-back skill cannot resume at its prior maturity; it can only be RETIRED or (outside this table, as a NEW SkillCandidate object with a new skill_id) re-enter at S0 (SCEN-12 negative proof).
Knowledge K1 has no edge back to K0 -- interpretation may be revised via a NEW superseding Knowledge Artifact (section 9), never by regressing the sealed one.

This table governs ONLY the four fail-learn object types (FailureEvidence/Experience/Knowledge/SkillCandidate) defined by WP1. It does not modify, replace, or interact with src/control/state-machine.mjs's pre-existing STATE_MACHINES table for Project/WorkPackage/Session/Evidence, which is a separate, already-implemented lifecycle for different object types.
